video.title: Genesis 4 - The Brother's Blood
video.notes: Revised 312-second Genesis 4 lyric film for Shane. Preserves the accepted song, all 498 canonical word cues, measured beats, key story photographs, Cain's club attack and the embodied Christophany. Replaces repetitive background-and-entrance cycling with 32 new spatial camera and semantic word choreographies plus two preserved bespoke scenes: 34 total treatments, no more than three uses, no repeated three-scene sequence. Camera journeys follow phrases rather than accelerating every syllable. New opening photograph and contemporary Archivo Black title. Independent visual review and exact encode checks; strict automatic sung-word certification remains unresolved, as in the accepted original. Source song https://suno.com/song/dd723dc8-5303-4694-9553-6d29f9768d04. Film SHA256 21a351db6f10d75e48dd32afeb399ee10b608737259f416458f686c7c94e5777.
